social_rules: All spoken promises must be weighed in grams of lead foil before they can be filed
Unpaid vows accrue interest daily and are subject to summary erasure by the Silent Office
Generated gameplay loops should create follow-up choices instead of dead ends.
Player entry points should remain understandable through local conversation, movement, and inspection.
Conflict hook: Escalating syllable taxes cause mass abandonment of pledges and rising default rates
Conflict hook: Expanding mute zones delay courier transit and accrue massive debt interest
